_comment: The list of valid emotional states, and the placeholder color for each (used only when no real avatar file exists at nori/static/avatars/<name>.<ext> -- see that folder's README). Adding a state means adding an entry here (name + color, both required) plus an avatar file; no code change either way, BUT a brand-new state name needs a server restart to take effect (this file is only read once, at startup -- STATES/the tool's enum are fixed after that). Dropping in an avatar file for a state ALREADY in this list needs no restart. 'neutral' must stay in this list -- it's the decay target and the default for a user with no state set yet.
